name: Tracks
summary: Circuit layouts: centre line, widths, racing line, sectors, surfaces (track, kerb, grass, barrier), grid slots, and real elevation (heights, gradients, crests, banking, a terrain grid around the circuit). Track files are JSON in data/, made by tools/build_tracks.py (with tools/elevation.py) from tools/tracks.json.
notes: New tracks: add an entry to tools/tracks.json and run tools/build_tracks.py (see docs/ADDING_CONTENT.md). Every track has a pit_lane (path, side, entry/exit, speed limit, boxes) for wave 3.
